records.text: The White House Communications Agency is a Department of Defense-controlled military communications entity embedded in the White House whose primary functions include secure presidential communications, continuity infrastructure, and crisis command-and-control systems.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep Pb7UlpRdW6U)

appearances.snippet: So from some sources within the White House, I'm going to read this quote, the White House Communications Agency is a Department of Defense-controlled military communications entity. ... that is embedded inside of the White House itself. Its primary function is maintaining secure presidential communications, continuity infrastructure, and command and control systems during crises.

verification.notes: Official DISA material describes WHCA as a joint-service communications organization with administrative reporting to DISA and operational reporting to the White House Military Office. Official sources confirm assured presidential communications, continuity support, and command-and-control voice and video services.

sources.relevance: Official WHCA page describes assured global presidential communications and a joint-service organization.
